signal_matrix_schema.pit_c14_compliant: Usable_Date == Date (signal computed at month-end with t-1 lag features)

factor_specs.proxy: vrp_bkm_lag1 = (BKM 2003 RFS Q-measure variance) - RV_22d_annualized (lagged t-1)
factor_specs.formula: BKM 2003 RFS Theorem 1 — V(t,τ) = ∫S^∞ [2(1-ln(K/S))/K²]·C(K) dK + ∫0^S [2(1+ln(S/K))/K²]·P(K) dK. RV_22d_annual = sum(daily_var)·252/22.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Risk-neutral BKM 2003 variance minus realized variance — VRP is investor risk-aversion premium for equity variance exposure (Bollerslev-Tauchen-Zhou 2009 RFS).
references: Bakshi G., Kapadia N., Madan D. (2003) Stock Return Characteristics, Skew Laws, and the Differential Pricing of Individual Equity Options. RFS 16(1):101-143
Bondarenko O. (2014) Why Are Put Options So Expensive? JFE.
Carr P., Wu L. (2009) Variance Risk Premiums. RFS 22(3):1311-1341

factor_specs.formula: MFIV = (2/T)·e^(rT)·Σ(ΔK/K²)·Q(K) - (1/T)·(F/K_atm-1)². Carr-Wu 2009 RFS variance swap synthetic.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Variance swap synthetic — bias-free implied variance under no-arbitrage. Direct Q-measure variance (excludes higher moments).
references: Carr P., Wu L. (2009) Variance Risk Premiums. RFS 22(3):1311-1341

factor_specs.formula: VKOSPI = 100·sqrt((T1·σ²(T1)·w1 + T2·σ²(T2)·w2)·(365/30)). 30-day blend of front + next month MFIV.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Self-reconstructed VKOSPI matches KRX official series — 2020-03 92, 2017 50, 2026-04 110. CBOE methodology validated KRX implementation reproducible.

diagnostics.historical_consistency: aligns with KRX VKOSPI: 2020-03 92, 2017 50, 2026-04 110, validated 5 sample dates

factor_specs.formula: Bollerslev-Tauchen-Zhou 2009 RFS — VRP = E[RV] - implied variance. HAR-RV components (rv_d/rv_w/rv_m) computed for future production rolling fit.
factor_specs.economic_rationale: BTZ 2009 RFS — VRP predicts forward equity returns negatively. In-sample baseline; rolling HAR fit deferred.
references: Bollerslev T., Tauchen G., Zhou H. (2009) Expected Stock Returns and Variance Risk Premia. RFS 22(11):4463-4492
